intro.quote: A Path message SHOULD contain as specific an LSP (Label Switched Path) Encoding Type as possible to allow the maximum flexibility in switching by transit LSRs. A Generalized Label Request object is set by the ingress node, transparently passed by transit nodes, and used by the egress node.

steps.explain: The ingress node sets a generalized label request in the Path message. Transit nodes pass it onward, and the egress node uses it.

cite.quote: A Path message SHOULD contain as specific an LSP (Label Switched Path) Encoding Type as possible to allow the maximum flexibility in switching by transit LSRs. A Generalized Label Request object is set by the ingress node, transparently passed by transit nodes, and used by the egress node.

steps.explain: The generalized label is carried upstream in the Resv message.

cite.quote: The Generalized Label travels in the upstream direction in Resv messages.

intro.quote: The Notify message provides a mechanism to inform non-adjacent nodes of LSP related events. Notify messages are normally generated only after a Notify Request object has been received.

steps.explain: When an error will generate a PathErr and a matching Notify Request was received, the node sends a Notify message to the recorded target.

cite.quote: Notify messages are most commonly generated at nodes that detect an error that will trigger the generation of a PathErr or ResvErr message. If a PathErr message is to be generated and a Notify Request object has been received in the corresponding Path message, then a Notify message destined to the recorded node SHOULD be generated.

steps.explain: The notification target acknowledges the Notify message with an Ack message.

cite.quote: Upon receiving a Notify message, the Notify Node SHOULD send a corresponding Ack message.

intro.quote: The format of a Generalized Label Request object is:

fields.name: Length
fields.explain: Carries the length of the object.

fields.name: Class-Num
fields.explain: Identifies the object as class number 19.

fields.name: LSP Enc. Type
fields.explain: Carries the requested LSP encoding type.

fields.name: Switching Type
fields.explain: Carries the switching type that must be supported on the corresponding incoming interface.

cite.quote: Nodes MUST verify that the type indicated in the Switching Type parameter is supported on the corresponding incoming interface.

fields.name: G-PID
fields.explain: Carries the G-PID parameter that is normally examined at the egress.

cite.quote: The G-PID parameter is normally only examined at the egress.

intro.quote: The format of a Generalized Label object is:

fields.name: Length
fields.explain: Carries the length of the object.

fields.name: Class-Num
fields.explain: Identifies the object as class number 16.

fields.name: Label
fields.explain: Carries the generalized label value propagated upstream in a Resv message.

cite.quote: The Generalized Label travels in the upstream direction in Resv messages.
